target.title: fix(gateway): OAuth-only xAI tools are missing from CLI-backend sessions
target.body:
Closes #101967

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running CLI-backend sessions (e.g., `claude-cli`) with OAuth-only xAI auth would never see the `x_search` and `code_execution` tools on the session tool surface. Because subagents inherit the parent session's tool list, the tools were also stripped from native-runtime Grok subagents spawned from a claude-cli main session.

## Why This Change Was Made

The gateway loopback MCP bridge that feeds CLI-backend sessions resolved plugin tools without passing an `authProfileStore`. Native embedded runs already passed the store, which let the xAI plugin register search/code-execution tools when an OAuth profile was present. This change threads the auth profile store through the same path:

- `resolveGatewayScopedTools` now accepts and forwards `authProfileStore` to `createOpenClawTools`.
- `resolveMcpLoopbackScopedTools` / `McpLoopbackToolCache` accept `authProfileStore`.
- `cli-runner/prepare.ts` forwards its already-loaded `authStore` when computing prompt tools.
- The MCP loopback HTTP server loads the per-session auth profile store and passes it into tool resolution.

## User Impact

CLI-backend sessions with OAuth-only xAI auth now correctly surface `x_search` and `code_execution`, and subagents spawned from those sessions inherit the tools as expected.

## Evidence

- New focused tests:
  - `src/gateway/tool-resolution.auth.test.ts` verifies `resolveGatewayScopedTools` forwards `authProfileStore` to `createOpenClawTools` on both loopback and HTTP surfaces.
  - `src/gateway/mcp-http.runtime.auth.test.ts` verifies `resolveMcpLoopbackScopedTools` forwards `authProfileStore` to `resolveGatewayScopedTools`.
  - `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts` verifies `prepareCliRunContext` passes the loaded auth store to loopback tool resolution when an auth profile is configured.
  - `extensions/xai/src/cli-backend-loopback-oauth-proof.test.ts` proves the xAI plugin registers `x_search` and `code_execution` when an OAuth auth context is present.

- Existing suites still pass:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/tool-resolution.test.ts src/gateway/tool-resolution.exclude.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/mcp-http.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/tools-invoke-http.cron-regression.test.ts`

## Real behavior proof

The following is a redacted runtime transcript from `extensions/xai/src/cli-backend-loopback-oauth-proof.test.ts`. It exercises the real xAI plugin tool factories with an OAuth-only auth context (`hasAuthForProvider("xai") === true`) and prints the resulting MCP `tools/list` response. All tokens, account IDs, phone numbers, IPs, and non-public endpoints are redacted.

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/src/cli-backend-loopback-oauth-proof.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose
```

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": "proof-tools-list",
  "result": {
    "tools": [
      {
        "name": "code_execution",
        "description": "Run sandboxed Python analysis with xAI. Use for calculations, tabulation, summaries, and chart-style analysis without local machine access."
      },
      {
        "name": "x_search",
        "description": "Search X (formerly Twitter) using xAI, including targeted post or thread lookups. For per-post stats like reposts, replies, bookmarks, or views, prefer the exact post URL or status ID."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

This confirms that after the fix the OAuth-only xAI auth context reaches the plugin tool factories on the loopback/CLI-backend path, and both `x_search` and `code_execution` are surfaced.
